---
description: "Use when creating or updating tests in tests/**/*.test.ts for tournament logic, sync behavior, routing, and display formatting."
applyTo: "tests/**/*.test.ts"
---

# Test Instructions

- Use Node's built-in test runner style already used in this repository.
- Keep tests focused and deterministic with explicit fixtures.
- Assert behavior, not implementation details.
- When fixing a bug, add or update a test that would fail without the fix.
